messages:
tara: Opening thread for Starlake POC — they want to trial a custom variant called 'twin-neo-30b' on Dedicated. Need quick catalog fit + infra sizing + pricing delta. Also flagged KMS + security questionnaire as blockers.

jason: @tara can you drop the model config they sent? tokenizer, dtype, seq len?

lara: bumping in — I can help on model adapter if it's a HF-style checkpoint.

maria: Starlake contact (Lisa) shared this snippet:```model: twin-neo-30b
weights_dtype: float16
tokenizer: byte-level-bpe
max_seq: 8192
kv_cache_estimate: ~12GB per worker```

jason: ok float16 + bpe is good. Our catalog currently has a twin-neo-30b-q4f16 variant and a 16-bit baseline. The q4 variant saves ~2.4x memory but needs the new kernel.

nick: infra note — Dedicated node for 30B baseline needs 48GB GPU memory or multi-GPU split. If they want low latency (<150ms tail) we recommend pinned capacity with 2x A10s or 1x A100-80G. KV cache of 12GB suggests using 80G for single-worker; otherwise we shard which increases latency.

tara: pricing asks: what's the unit delta between baseline fp16 vs q4_0? and any engineering lift for private model adapter?

jason: short answer: q4_0 variant is ~40% cheaper per token than fp16 in our benchmarks, but quality varies on instruction-following tests. Adapter lift: if it's HF-compatible, minimal — ~1-2 engineer days to validate and push variant into catalog.

olivia: security Qs — they require KMS integration (customer-managed keys) + EKM logs + SOC2 export. We have KMS for Private and Dedicated, but need legal to OK EKM. Also they asked about model provenance and vulnerability scan reports.

maria: lisa (Starlake rep) — can you confirm if EKM is mandatory or just preferred? Also, any export control constraints?

lisa: EKM is mandatory. Export controls: model weights built in EU/US, no embargoed countries. Security questionnaire will be returned by EOD tomorrow.

nick: ops follow-up — if EKM + 80G nodes required, we should provision a short-lived Dedicated pool for the POC. Lead time ~3 business days.

jason: QA plan: we'll run a 2k-sample eval with their instruction set comparing fp16 vs q4_0. If quality regression <2% we approve q4_0 for POC. Need test harness + cost baseline.

tara: next steps I propose: (1) @nick provision a 7-day Dedicated pool (A100-80G) with KMS + logging, (2) @jason run adapter + eval, (3) @olivia review SQA answers when they arrive, (4) I'll send pricing addendum to Starlake. Agree? :eyes:

nick: I can start the provisioning tomorrow morning.

jason: will schedule the eval once we have the model artifact. drop artifact into our secure bucket and ping me.

olivia: will review the questionnaire on receipt, pinging legal if EKM needs extra approvals.

deploy-bot: provisioning request received for pool: starlake-poc-7411122334 — ETA 72h for A100-80G with KMS integration.

tara: thanks everyone. I'll consolidate action items and loop in legal/AE.

lisa: thanks team — will send questionnaire + model artifact this afternoon.
